evidence: The Scottish Government requested military aerial support around Aug 1 (UK Defence Journal); the UK Government answered with availability - Chinooks and standby battalions ready if requested (Press and Journal; UK Defence Journal, early Aug) - but the MoD could not supply the aerial firefighting capability sought and the offered support was declined, with Neil Gray saying ground crews had the resources needed (Wikipedia, 2026 Cairngorms wildfire; Press and Journal timeline). No MoD or Scottish Government confirmation of an actual military deployment to the fire appears in major press within the window; the SFRS Aug 5 update lists four appliances, about 20 firefighters and civilian helicopter support, with Glenmore planned to reopen Aug 7.
disconfirming: Headlines such as UK offers Chinooks and troops read as deployment at a glance; the body text in each case is an offer pending request or a request awaiting response, which is exactly the distinction the criterion turns on.
note: Request made, availability offered, capability mismatch, offer declined - at no point a confirmed deployment. Window edge checked: SFRS de-escalation by Aug 5-7 makes a late deployment implausible and none is reported.
